content:
Just after catching AirPods Pro 3 dropping to one of their lowest prices ever, the floodgates have opened for fall Prime Day deals covering the newest Mac offerings. The M6 Mac mini lineup is hitting new all-time low prices with up to nearly $150 off, while the 2026 Mac Studio is seeing discounts approaching $200.

On top of that, the entire M5 MacBook Air range is $200 off across all configurations, ongoing $500 discounts on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, the first price cut on Apple's brand new minimalist full-character Magic Keyboard, as well as rare savings on the Magic Mouse.

For those looking to pick up a MacBook, fall Prime Day has brought the lowest prices in months for the Apple M5 MacBook Air lineup. Amazon is now offering a solid $200 off on nearly every configuration, with most models available in multiple colors:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,399 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (originally $1,999)

Amazon this morning brought a slew of notable price drops across Apple's brand new Mac mini lineup. From the entry-level M6 configuration to the more powerful M5 Max model, discounts reach up to $149 off, marking all-time low prices:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (originally $899) — all-time low price
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (originally $1,099) — all-time low price
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (originally $1,699) — all-time low price

On top of those deals, the new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM is also at an all-time low, with $199 off at Amazon — the best price we've seen since its launch last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (originally $2,499) — all-time low price

While we're still waiting for (and hoping for) more MacBook Pro deals to land, Amazon is still offering $500 off this upgraded 2TB configuration — a discount that brings the price $100 below its official retail price before the increase:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199)

In addition, we've also tracked deals on a few Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, the Magic Mouse in both black and white is now enjoying rare discounts of up to nearly 25% off; as for Apple's brand new Magic Keyboard with a minimalist full-character design that just launched, it's also seeing its first price cut:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (new 2026 model) $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse (white) $60 (originally $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse (black) $80 (originally $99)
